# FeeFallback

The fallback information of an estimated transaction fee.

## Properties

Name | Type | Description | Notes
------------ | ------------- | ------------- | -------------
**fallback** | **bool** | Whether the estimated transaction fee is generated by Cobo&#39;s fallback mechanism. Cobo uses the fallback mechanism when a normal fee estimation cannot be completed, for example when the blockchain node fails to estimate the gas limit. - &#x60;true&#x60;: The returned &#x60;gas_limit&#x60; is produced by Cobo&#39;s internal fallback strategy instead of a node estimation. It can differ significantly from the gas units that the transaction actually consumes, and a transaction submitted with this value may fail. Check &#x60;fallback_reason&#x60; and use the value with caution. - &#x60;false&#x60;: The returned fee values are generated by a normal fee estimation.  | [optional] 
**fallback_reason** | **str** | The reason why Cobo&#39;s fallback mechanism was used, such as the error message returned by the blockchain node. This property is returned only when &#x60;fallback&#x60; is &#x60;true&#x60;.  | [optional]
